newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Roll satisfied w/Q1 orders.
newsitem.headline: Von Roll satisfied w/Q1 orders.

text.p: Von Roll Holding AG is satisfied with its order volume and turnover was moderate during the 1997 first quarter, chairman and chief executive Max Amstutz said.
"In the first quarter our order volume was satisfactory, the turnover moderate," Amstutz said in a copy of a speech released ahead of a news conference.
Amstutz also said economic conditions in 1997 were still unfavourable, with Switzerland stagnating and the European economy remaining weak.
"The picture is brightening due to a decline of the Swiss franc," he said.
"Due to a first estimate we expect a further increase of our results in all three core divisions for this year," Amstutz also said.
Von Roll's three core businesses after it shed its steel-making activities are electrical isolation materials, Infratec engineering and its Inova waste distruction plants.
